headline: X Deploys AI to Stop Content Thieves, Redirects $1M to Original Creators
reasoning: This topic scores high due to its strong mix of tech giant drama (X), mainstream relevance (social media content theft), and practical value for a huge creator community. The use of AI to solve a common platform problem is highly clickable, and the story lends itself to multiple engaging formats like explainers or hot takes on the creator economy.
summary: X is using an updated version of its Grok AI to detect stolen content and engagement bait, automatically redirecting monetization from copycat posts back to the original creators. The platform will also remove repeat offenders from its revenue-sharing program.

source_articles.title: X cracks down on creators who steal content
source_articles.excerpt: X will use Grok AI to better detect stolen content, redirect payouts to original creators, and crack down on engagement bait.
